nodes.name: Incident Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives incidents from error handler, pipeline monitor, and other workflows. Copy Production URL to INCIDENT_ROUTER_WEBHOOK_URL env var.

nodes.name: Cursor Auto-Fix Webhook
nodes.notes: Tier 1 and 2 only. Set CURSOR_AUTOMATION_WEBHOOK_URL and CURSOR_AUTOMATION_TOKEN (Bearer crsr_...) from cursor.com/automations.

meta.description: Central incident router: normalize, dedupe (6h), classify Tier 1/2/3, Telegram always, Cursor webhook for Tier 1-2.
